notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
openvasreporting converts OpenVAS/GVM XML scan reports to Excel (XLSX), CSV, or HTML formats for easier analysis, client reporting, and remediation tracking. Raw OpenVAS XML is difficult to work with manually.

=== CHAINING ===
OpenVAS scan → export XML report → openvasreporting -i report.xml -o output.xlsx → Excel: filter by severity, sort by CVSS, create remediation tracking spreadsheet.

=== REPORT CONTENT ===
XLSX includes: vulnerability name, CVSS score, affected hosts, CVE IDs, description, solution recommendations. Provides sortable/filterable data for prioritization and tracking.
